args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10-20, 2024

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- Sunglasses
- Hat or cap for sun protection
- Beach towel
- Flip flops/Beach sandals

Clothing:
- Casual outfits (lightweight, breathable fabrics)
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike)
- Dressier outfit for the Luau experience
- Sleepwear

Electronics:
- Camera
- Phone charger
- Portable power bank
- Travel adapter (if needed)

Documents & Essentials:
- Travel documents (passport, ID, flight tickets)
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Travel insurance information
- Credit cards and cash
- Emergency contact information

Activity-Specific Items:
- Snorkeling gear (or plan to rent at Hanauma Bay)
- Waterproof phone case
- Reusable water bottle
- Small backpack for day trips
- Beach bag

Personal Items:
- Toiletries
- Medications
- Insect repellent
- After-sun lotion or aloe vera gel
